title: 국회상설소위원회설치등에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Composition)
A standing subcommittee shall have no more than 12 members, including its chairperson, and the number of members shall be determined by the relevant Standing Committee.
